name: Colombian Huila Decaf
description:
Our first  decaf , and it’s anything but boring. This coffee comes from  San Agustín, Huila , grown at  1900 MASL,  where the cool altitude brings depth and sweetness to every bean. 
 It’s  washed processed , then decaffeinated using the  DCM method  : a gentle extraction that keeps the flavour, loses the caffeine. 
 Roasted  medium-dark for espresso , this cup hits like a cozy dessert : Valencia Orange zest ,  roasted hazelnuts , and  chocolate spread  all rolled into one smooth finish. Perfect for your  espresso machine, moka pot, AeroPress, or French press . 
 All the taste. None of the jitters.

name: Monsoon Malabar AA
description:
A method unique to India, where the beans undergo a monsooning process for a duration of 3 months near the Malabar coast where they are exposed to the moist monsoon winds to give them a unique flavour profile and in the process the beans swell up and fade resulting in a nutty and earthy coffee with reduced levels of acidity.  
    This    coffee is one of the world’s most sought after Indian coffees across the world, we have profiled this coffee as a medium roast to highlight the balance and sweetness of the coffee. Monsoon Malabar is a treat for the fresh press, mokapot and espresso brewers.

name: Ratnagiri Hydro Honey (SCA 86+)
description:
This lot from  Ratnagiri Estate, Chikmagalur  is a refined expression of the  Hydro Honey process,  a method that  blends elements of washed, natural, and honey processing  to create a cup with layered complexity and clarity. 
 Ripe cherries are carefully selected  based on their sugar content  to ensure peak sweetness. They are first sun-dried briefly like a natural, then  rehydrated (soaked)  to refine the profile, before  being depulped and slowly dried again  with controlled mucilage, similar to a honey process. This multi-stage approach is labour-intensive but results in exceptional balance and depth. 
 The cup is delicate and expressive, opening with notes of  peach tea and soft florals . A clean  sugarcane sweetness  runs through, with layers of  stone fruit  add gentle juiciness and depth as the cup cools. 
  Light roasted  to preserve its vibrancy, this coffee is bright, elegant, and structured, ideal for  Pour-over, AeroPress, and other manual brews.
